text: This renovation website is quietly losing jobs. Let's roast it.
Saltbush Reno Co. Made up, but you've definitely seen this site.
First, the slider. Five photos, swapping every two seconds. Nobody reads a slide that leaves before they finish it.
Second, the headline: Quality you can trust. Trust to do what? Kitchens? Decks? Where?
Third, the phone number is a picture. You can't tap it to call, so people have to remember it.
Fourth, 200 gallery photos with no captions. What job was it? Which suburb? How long did it take?
say: Fourth, two hundred gallery photos with no captions. What job was it? Which suburb? How long did it take?

text: And the quote form asks for your budget before your name. That's like asking someone's salary on a first date.
The fix: say what you build and where. Make the number tappable. Caption your best ten jobs.
Which one would make you leave? Follow for the next website roast.
